prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas. Injury: whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1445; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was changing lanes on a multi-lane road in Sugar Land, Texas, checking my mirror and signaling as I moved over. As I began to merge, the vehicle in the next lane came alongside me and its side made contact with the side of my car, pushing my vehicle slightly toward the shoulder. Both cars stopped, and we exchanged insurance and contact details at the roadside. I have been the named driver on this policy throughout the period it has been in force, and I have given the same description of what happened to every person I have spoken with about the collision. Afterward I felt a stiff, aching pain in my neck and upper back, which I was later diagnosed with as whiplash. I am reporting the incident and the injury so that the claim can be processed.
